Sentence (English): We ordered it on Monday and on Thursday at 8:30 we had it installed, which means we were very happy.
Comments (English): [ Pretty and quiet ] || ---------------- || We ordered it on Monday and on Thursday at 8:30 we had it installed, which means we were very happy. As I said, although there are still many dishes, glasses, cutlery to wash. Sentence (English): Although I was sure I wanted a Bosch dishwasher, it was hard for me to decide on this model because I was quite reluctant to have the upper tray for cutlery.
Comments (English): [ MUY SILENCIOSO Y APROVECHAMIENTO TOTAL DEL ESPACIO ] || ---------------- || Although I was sure I wanted a Bosch dishwasher, it was hard for me to decide on this model because I was quite reluctant to have the upper tray for cutlery. After using it for about two months I have realised that it is a success since you have the cutlery closer at hand to collect it and avoid cuts with knives, etc. It also holds a large amount of these. It has a very varied number of programmes, but I recommend the automatic programme and the extra drying option is activated, the plastic containers come out wonderfully. You can also programme the connection time and thus be able to save electricity with the hours when it is cheaper. It is very quiet and when it finishes it switches off automatically. The only drawback I see (I suppose because it is new) is that it is a bit difficult to open the door. I recommend it 100%.
Comments (Original): [ MUY SILENCIOSO Y APROVECHAMIENTO TOTAL DEL ESPACIO ] || ---------------- || Si bien tenia claro que qieria un lavavajillas bosh, me costo decidirme por este modelo pues era bastante reacio a la bandeja superior para cubieros. Tras un periodo de uso de unos dos meses me he dado cuenta de que es un acierto puesto que tienes los cubiertos mas a mano para recogerlos y evitar cortes con los cuchillos, etc. Ademas cabe una gran cantidad de estos. Tiene una cantidad muy variada de programas, pero recomiendo el programa automatico y se activa la opcion de secado extra lo recipientes de plastico quedan de maravilla.Tambien se puede programar la hora de conexion y asi poder ahorrar electricidad con las horas en la que esta es mas barata.Es muy silencioso y al acabar se desconecta automaticamente.La unica pega que le veo (supongo que por que es nuevo) es que cuesta un poco abrir la puerta.Recomiendo su 100%

Sentence (English): All of the problems mentioned by others?
Comments (English): [ 100 series -- very similar ] || ---------------- || All of the problems mentioned by others? Same -- dishes not drying completely, and silverware always wet and having to hand dry. Dirty water in the filter basket drain (? ). Silverware baskets not able to sit properly, due to poor design. We called Bosch, and got a tech out. And the solutions? And as a note, the Tech got on the phone with Bosch rep directly and followed instructions over the phone. 1. Use only Finish dish soap with special triple action chemicals. Why? Apparently the Bosch DW are designed for the Finish special detergent. So much for low water, low energy, save the world efficiency. All I want are clean dishes without special, special treatment. 2. Must use -- I repeat -- must use Finish Jet dry, not exceptions. Yep, another chemical additive. 3. Tech increased the dry time by 30 minutes -- a special setting -- so much for energy efficiency. The Tech gave us special instructions for undoing this added time just in case we decide not use it. 4. Dirty water left behind in the Filter drain? Normal, we are told. What? So, it is normal for the dish washing to leave behind dirty water after it rinses cleaned dishes with last rinse? I brought this up three times, and the same answer -- That's normal. 5. Sentence (English): We moved into a brand new house.
Comments (English): [ Miserable experience ] || ---------------- || We moved into a brand new house. The builder had installed the dishwasher the day prior to house closing. We paid extra to the builder to upgrade the kitchen appliances . The Kitchenaid dishwasher is NOT working from day one. Thinking that the builder would replace it, I called him. He said I should call Kitchenaid. The service man that kitchenaid sent is knowledgeable and polite. He has made 3 visits. The control board, the control panel, the vent has been replaced already. There was also a screw missing in the door, which makes me think that someone has worked on the dishwasher before. Initially it was not cleaning the dishes in the normal cycle , other cycles did not work at all and water was left in it at end of cycle. Now it works but is leaking water from the door. So, the door is going to be changed next. The builder has NOT contacted his preferred supplier( the one supplied it at the last minute) to replace the unit in spite of my suggesting he do that. Instead , he told me to call Kitchenaid. Meantime, we have to manually wash the dishes and dinnerware. It's been 5 week's already. Also when I had called to register the dishwasher ( and also Kitchenaid Combo oven, Whirlpool cooktop ) the agent was pestering me to buy an extended warranty. He continued pushing me to buy it for 25 minutes. Then when I called the service department about the repair, they told me NONE of the appliances were registered though the previous person took model and serial numbers of each of them. So, your customer is paying for it in terms labor and anguish and he has paid for a NEW unit. Kitchenaid is spending money on parts and labor. I do not even know whether I am receiving refurbished replacement parts. Whereas the builder's supplier ( whose name had not been revealed to me ) who should bear the responsibility of replacing the dishwasher has not been notified by Kitchenaid or the builder. Why is he sheltered? How long do you expect me to wait patiently.

Sentence (English): I've owned this machine for 7 months now, Bosch has checked the machine multiple times and claims that it is working correctly, despite repeated E31 errors and despite the machine randomly changing cycles and settings even while it is running!
Comments (English): [ Decent, when it's working correctly. ] || ---------------- || I've owned this machine for 7 months now, Bosch has checked the machine multiple times and claims that it is working correctly, despite repeated E31 errors and despite the machine randomly changing cycles and settings even while it is running! The tech informed me that the E-31 errors occur because the dishwasher is not intended to be run with pods or packs. I was told that a teaspoon of gel or power detergent should only be used. I tried the teaspoon of gel and ended up with dirty dishes. The E31 error is the result of Aqua Stop, a feature that is supposed to prevent the unit from leaking. It doesn't work. The Aqua Stop kicks in 10 minutes before the rinse cycle is finished. In the meantime, the wash and rinse water already flooded the kitchen floor. However, on other days, the unit runs fine with the same dishes and detergent set to the same cycle and options. It obviously has a faulty microprocessor or a faulty onboard memory chip, but Bosch won't repair it unless it gives an error code indicating that there is a problem with it. It also changes settings at random. I may set the unit to run Auto with Crystal Dry for a total time of 2:28 and 4 hours later it is still running a different cycle and option combination. At other times, it stops mid cycle and resets to factory settings. But again, without an error code, Bosch says everything is fine. It has the dishwasher equivalent of dimentia and I'm supposed to wait for it to realize that it has a memory problem and tell me what it is before I'm able to get it serviced! On the rare occasion that it is working right, it is quiet, and gets the dishes clean and reasonably dry. But the highly touted Crystal Dry does no better than Sanitize alone with the Extended Dry setting on. A big disadvantage is that several necessary common settings are ONLY available though Wifi and the App. The Rinse Cycle, Delayed Start, and Delicate Cycles are only accessible with the App. Also, there is no drying option at all available with the One Hour Cycle, a SERIOUS deficiency in my opinion. Personally, I think this dishwasher is a techonological nightmare and I'm sorry I purchased it. I'm seriously thinking of just giving up and replacing it with another brand that doesn't use Wifi or an App and allows for heated dry during the short cycle and where all the cycles, options, and start and stop functions are on the touchpad.

Sentence (English): This is our fourth dishwasher (over 20 years and extremely hard water) in the same space.
Comments (English): [ Check plumbing placement! ] || ---------------- || This is our fourth dishwasher (over 20 years and extremely hard water) in the same space. This time, the configuration for the dishwasher (the drain, the water, etc) had to be moved because something UNDER the dishwasher has changed. Fortunately, we are skilled enough to know how to do the plumping, but don't assume you can just put in place, attach hoses, plug in and go, like the last ones which have been Whirlpool and Maytag. Without re-plumbing, we cannot push the dishwasher all the way back and it sticks out about 1/2 inch from the counter, and no where does it say anything. Otherwise, it works as we expected. (For those debating on the 3rd top rack, I find it rather useless unless you have kids with sippy cups. Then it's great).

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher after my other Whirlpool bit the dust after about 10 years.
Comments (English): [ Great purchase ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher after my other Whirlpool bit the dust after about 10 years. The design of this one is very well thought out with the extra shelf on top being a bonus for all those spatulas and tiny bowls that can fall between the cracks of the other shelves. The adjustable middle rack is super handy when you have bigger items on the bottom rack or taller cups or plates that need to fit on the middle rack. The motor is extremely quiet, cleans as it should, and it dries everything really well. If I had any complaint about it at all it would be that the extra shelf on top doesn't pull out very smoothly and makes me wonder that it may break before too long. Other than that I am very satisfied with this purchase.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is working properly.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing after-sales service ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is working properly. I have had it for less than a month, but the after-sales service has been very disappointing, after deciding to buy the appliance through the official LG website, as one thinks that the guarantee and after-sales service will be better. The dishwasher has rubber bands stuck vertically on each side of the door with a kind of double-sided tape. During the first wash cycle, the one on the left side came off, possibly due to steam, heat or humidity. I have tried to stick it back on, but after each wash cycle the rubber bands come off. I contact the after-sales service and they tell me that the rubber bands are not important, that if the dishwasher has not been in use for very long, I do not need to put them back on. After insisting that I would like to have an appliance installed with all the components included correctly, as it is not even a month old, they tell me that the technician I hired (since it is an integrated dishwasher) will have to come and reinstall it, as it is an installation fault. The technician has "installed" or glued it (since there is no mystery to it) 4 times and after each wash it comes off. So he tells me that I have to buy a new rubber as it is considered an accessory and is not included in the warranty. It is no longer about what the "accessory" may cost, it is about the attention and detail after buying an appliance that costs around €1,000.
Comments (Original): [ Servicio Post-venta decepcionante ] || ---------------- || El lavavajillas podría decir que funciona correctamente. No hace un mes que lo tengo, sin embargo ha sido muy decepcionante la atención post-venta, después de decidir comprar el electrodoméstico a través de la web oficial de LG ya que uno piensa que la garantía y la atención post-venta serán mejores. El lavavajillas lleva pegadas, con una especie de cinta de doble cara, verticalmente a cada lado de la puerta unas gomas. En el primer ciclo de lavado la del lado izquierdo se despegó, posiblemente a causa del vapor, el calor o la humedad. Se ha intentado pegar de nuevo pero tras cada ciclo de lavado la goma se despega. Me pongo en contacto con el servicio post-venta y me indican que la goma no tiene importancia, que si no hace mucho el lavavajillas no hace falta que la coloque. Tras insistir que me gustaría tener un electrodoméstico instalado con todos los componentes que incluye correctamente ya que no tiene ni un mes, me indican que tendrá que ir el técnico que yo contraté (ya que es un lavavajillas de integración) para volver a instalarlo ya que es un fallo de instalación. El técnico lo ha 'instalado' o pegado (ya que no tiene más misterio) 4 veces y después de cada lavado se despega. Así que me indica que tengo que comprar una nueva goma ya que se considera un accesorio y no está incluido en la garantía. Ya no es por lo que puede costar el 'accesorio', es la atención y el detalle después de comprar un electrodoméstico que vale alrededor de 1.000€.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to replace our FP dish drawers.
Comments (English): [ Good washer, installation service needs to improve ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace our FP dish drawers. Asko dishwater is very stylish and the touch controls are well designed and easy to use. We really like the auto-door opening feature after the wash cycle. We would have liked to see the dishes dried out a bit more, but it is still acceptable. The biggest drawback with this buy is not the dishwasher itself. It is with Asko's installation service. Two men came to install. One was extremely experienced and the other appears to be a complete novice. After a bit of struggle to remove the old dishwasher, they managed to get this washer under the bench. The experienced man left to drop off the old washer to their truck. At this point, the second man struggled to level the washer. After multiple attempts, he gave up. When the experienced person returned, he basically levelled it in a couple minutes! The experienced man kept being interrupted by calls to his phone. During those time, when the novice guy takes over, every activity takes a longer time. It finally came the time to connect the hoses, and the standard hoses were too short and it turned out they didn't have any spare in their truck. A couple of days later, a new team came. They installed both inlet and outlet hoses, and the inlet hose started leaking. One went to their truck and came back with a used hose. Once they fixed and tested, they said all working ok. When we used it for the first time later that night, one hose started leaking. When I looked closely at the hose, it was a old hose with a deep kink in it! After calling Asko service multiple times before getting through, and they sent another team. During this third visit, they finally installed a brand new hose and carefully checked for leaks. Even though Asko products are good, their installation service is a big turn off.

Sentence (English): The benchmark dishwasher works amazingly.
Comments (English): [ Amazing dishwasher, missing a couple of features ] || ---------------- || The benchmark dishwasher works amazingly. It requires little to no pre-rinsing, and dishes come out spotless. It's almost silent. We love that it uses chemical heating, so plastic can go anywhere without risk of melting. Dishes come out much drier than our old GE profile. The entire inside is stainless, and the stainless on the front is significant higher quality than our our SS appliances, so it does not water stain, and is much more dent resistant. The water softener is nice, especially because we are on shelf water, which is extremely hard (works great). We also like the ability to control the wash power in quadrants, but generally the AI feature does the job. The internal light is surprisingly nice, I didn't think I'd care about this at first, but it's a good feature. We also like that the racks extend fully. My biggest complaint is that it does NOT display when the wash is completed; the display with count down on the door is a nice feature, but it just shuts off after it's done running. It notifies you in the app, but the problem is this: everyone in your home has to have access to the app and be checking it regularly (not convenient or practical). If you forget if you've started it, started it at night, or when out of the house, you will have to open the app to determine if it's clean. I installed a braided water supply line with a "Flood Defender" valve that is supposed to activate if there is a rapid water flow (As in the hose bursts or something happens in the dishwasher mechanics that allow free flowing water from the hose.) It shuts down the free flow and can be reset after the problem is dealt with. Very pleased and recommend this Whirlpool dishwasher for your consideration if you are looking for a new one without all the "Smart" electronics.

After seeing how low the door is to the floor when open, we are very glad we did not get the towel bar handle. Overall, we are very pleased with this dishwasher. It is amazingly quiet! We only have two complaints. First are the longer cycle times, which it seems like all dishwashers now have. There's only room for a cutting board, so for me, a kitchen appliance, this was a must! So I searched for the smallest, no-installation option. That's when I found this Minix dishwasher! My favorite feature is the automatic door opening after washing. (Without this, it smells.) The delivery was also very meticulously packaged! After it arrived, I had to install it. Not only did I get the manual, but there was also a QR code on each page that I could scan to watch a video explaining everything. Even though I'm a single woman, it was easy to install! My first impression was, "I made the right purchase." All I had to do was press the button and get back to work! It saves so much time. I can just put it back and go out with peace of mind, which is great. Comments (English): [ Dishwasher "the phantom leak" ] || ---------------- || LC code not even 2 months into owning this fine piece of equipment. LC means leak. but good luck finding that leak. I looked around couldn't find anything. Called my local plumber to look around machine and check the connections the best buy team did when installing, he said everything looks fine to him. So i call best buy they redirect me to Samsung call Samsung. They read from their scripts as politely and kindly as they can. However what they dont tell you is all the stuff you will need to make this call actually get to a end. let me give you guys all this info for when your dishwasher decided to no longer work. take a picture of the code happening. This was most amusing because they say to unplug the dishwasher to troubleshoot. no power no code showing. so now you need the washer to go through another 3 hour cycle to have it code somewhere within that time. dont worry it will code again you just dont know when and Samsung cant wait 3 hours on the phone. you cant either so you will have to call back when you have the code. After that fun then someone will ask ok can you get the receipt. Ok cant remember where i put a receipt from 10 min ago let alone over a month. Lucky thanks to tech you can now get them off the wonderful internet. I did the old person thing of taking a picture of the screen of my monitor because again i had samsung on phone and didnt want to slow down their day, they said i cant do that i need to do an actual screen shot from comp i get the screen shot i ask for an email they provide i get this part of the tale done. So after all this i forgot another crucial piece of info. They want the serial number and model of the dishwasher that's right inside when you open it, its on the top lip. its in the smallest font possible so thats another fun issue i end up taking a picture of that blowing it up on phone so i can actually read the eye test of a set of numbers and letters. That's everything you need to actual get a ticket made for a team to come out. now im waiting another 24 to 48 hours for that to happen not even sure who/when this will happen. no contact yet. PS I am a huge Samsung fan all my monitors and TVs are Samsung . i am now worried for my fridge which is Samsung . in future i think i will stick with TVs and monitors and stay away from appliances.

I don't believe my problem was an isolated incident, I believe LG is well versed to this particular problem and that there is a design flaw in the motor. Sentence (English): I have been using it for more than 2 months, washing it on average 5 out of 7 days a week.
Comments (English): [ RECOMMENDATIONS ] || ---------------- || I have been using it for more than 2 months, washing it on average 5 out of 7 days a week. It does not come with a water hardness test and I had to purchase it separately, for the proper adjustment of the salt dosage. After 2-3 washes, I found the dosage for the cleaner. It has the option of connecting to hot water, to save electricity. My water consumption decreased by approximately 2 cubic meters per month, from 12 to 10 cubic meters. Otherwise it cleans very well. Tested with unrinsed dishes, with chickpeas, dry semolina, pasta, melted mozzarella, oven tray and grill, etc. The top drawer is height adjustable. You receive notifications on your phone when you finish washing, when you need to add salt/clarifier, when the capsules run out, etc. I do not recommend the short programs for any model of dishwasher, if you do not urgently need clean dishes, because it consumes a lot of water and a lot of unnecessary electricity. I mainly wash with long programs of 4-5 hours, with the extra silent option, if I wash in the evening.
Comments (Original): [ recomand ] || ---------------- || O folosesc de mai bine de 2 luni de zile, spalat in medie 5 din 7 zile pe saptamana.Nu vine cu test pentru duritatea apei si a trebuit sa-l achizitionez separat, pentru reglajul corespunzator al dozajului sarii.Dupa 2-3 spalari am nimerit si dozajul pentru limpezitor.Are optiunea de conectare la apa calda, pentru a economisi energie electrica.Mi-a scazut consumul la apa cu aproximativ 2mc pe luna, de la 12 la 10 mc.In rest curata foarte bine. Testat cu vase fara a fi clatite inainte, cu mamaliga, gris uscat, paste, mozarella topita, tava si gratarul de la cuptor etc.Sertarul de sus este reglabil pe inaltime.Primesti notificari pe telefon cand termina de spalat, cand trebuie sa completezi sare/limpezitor, cand se termina capsulele etc.Nu recomand programele scurte la nici un model de masina de spalat vase, daca nu ai nevoie urgent de vase curate, pentru ca se consuma multa apa si mult curent inutil. Eu spal predominat la programe lungi de 4-5h, cu optiunea extra silent, daca pun seara la spalat.

Sentence (English): This review is for our Bosch 500 series dishwasher after a little over one month's use.
Comments (English): [ So Far, So Good! ] || ---------------- || This review is for our Bosch 500 series dishwasher after a little over one month's use. This dishwasher replaced a 10 year old Kitchenaid. The biggest difference is the almost total absence of sound when it runs. With the previous dishwasher, you almost had to leave the room to have a conversation on the phone. Another significant improvement is that almost everything is dry when it's finished. Previously, we would have to use a towel to dry approximately 25% of the dishes before putting them away. And finally, it is now rare to find anything that the dishwasher did not remove. This was not the case with the Kitchenaid. Only the first month, but very impressed.

Sentence (English): When we built our home over 20 years ago, we installed a Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher. Previous Bosch DW Owner ] || ---------------- || When we built our home over 20 years ago, we installed a Bosch dishwasher. It finally died when a piece of plastic from a broken utensil damaged the recirculation motor. The part was no longer available. If the part had been available, it might have lasted another 10 years. The new dishwasher was delivered by Lowes with care, and I installed the dishwasher in less than an hour. The new 800 series dishwasher has water and power connections on the back where our previous Bosch dishwasher had the connections on the front. It comes with a power cord that fits a standard outlet. but we needed the junction box (sold separately) to connect it to our power. In hindsight, I'd have installed an outlet in the back of the dishwasher cabinet, though the junction box is fine. The third rack/tray is new for us, and we really enjoy the third tray for washing silverware, small condiment bowls, and utensils like spatulas, mixing spoons, etc. We prefer the layout of the tines and racks much better than our previous Bosch dishwasher. The 800 series layout is more versatile, so I see that as an improvement. The tines are thinner, but that is a benefit as it allows more items to be added to the same space. Some tines fold down for even more customization. The smaller utensil basket makes sense with the third rack being used primarily for this purpose. We may eventually remove the small basket completely. One thing I noticed right away was that the middle rack seemed very loose with side-to-side play compared to our previous Bosch dishwasher, and this at first seemed like less precision and less durable construction, but then I realized the middle rack has the ability to be canted with one side higher/lower than the other to accommodate tall pots or pans in the lower basket. This is a nice design feature that I think often flies under the radar for most that own this dishwasher. I'm assuming that some of the play in the middle rack is due to this greater adjustment ability. The height adjustment feet in front and the adjustable rear foot set by turning a screw on the front is brilliant. It made leveling the unit so easy! The one thing I view as a negative is the front door. The brushed steel skin flexes easily when pressed. This feels cheap and doesn't match a premium dishwasher. The front door also flexes from side to side and could easily be twisted. The door simply needs more reinforcement. Our previous Bosch, which was a lower-end model at the time, had a much sturdier door. I like the white light when running better than the red LED projected onto the floor. Frankly, that red LED light would drive our Jack Russell insane. He doesn't notice the white LED on the door panel. The unit isn't quite as quiet as I was expecting. We do have our unit installed in a cabinet with hardwood floors and butcherblock countertop, and perhaps this creates an acoustic cabinet that amplifies the sound. I will likely pull the dishwasher back out, add some additional sound insulation, and then re-install it. As some reviews have stated and I agree, the responsiveness of the controls could be improved. Sometimes it takes a couple of tries to register my selections. But, honestly. now that I've tested the various options for awhile, 99% of the time I will simply press Start, so this isn't a concern for me. The dishes, glassware, stainless cups, pots and pans, and utensils have come out pristine using Cascade Platinum with the Bosch 800. We don't wash much plastic, so I turned off Crystal Dry and will only use it when washing plastic. Overall, I'm very happy with the dishwasher and hope it has a long life like our last Bosch.

The new dishwasher was delivered by Lowes with care, and I installed the dishwasher in less than an hour. The new 800 series dishwasher has water and power connections on the back where our previous Bosch dishwasher had the connections on the front. It comes with a power cord that fits a standard outlet. but we needed the junction box (sold separately) to connect it to our power. In hindsight, I'd have installed an outlet in the back of the dishwasher cabinet, though the junction box is fine. The third rack/tray is new for us, and we really enjoy the third tray for washing silverware, small condiment bowls, and utensils like spatulas, mixing spoons, etc. We prefer the layout of the tines and racks much better than our previous Bosch dishwasher. The 800 series layout is more versatile, so I see that as an improvement. The tines are thinner, but that is a benefit as it allows more items to be added to the same space. Some tines fold down for even more customization. The smaller utensil basket makes sense with the third rack being used primarily for this purpose. We may eventually remove the small basket completely. One thing I noticed right away was that the middle rack seemed very loose with side-to-side play compared to our previous Bosch dishwasher, and this at first seemed like less precision and less durable construction, but then I realized the middle rack has the ability to be canted with one side higher/lower than the other to accommodate tall pots or pans in the lower basket. This is a nice design feature that I think often flies under the radar for most that own this dishwasher. I'm assuming that some of the play in the middle rack is due to this greater adjustment ability. The height adjustment feet in front and the adjustable rear foot set by turning a screw on the front is brilliant. It made leveling the unit so easy! The one thing I view as a negative is the front door. The brushed steel skin flexes easily when pressed. This feels cheap and doesn't match a premium dishwasher. But, honestly. now that I've tested the various options for awhile, 99% of the time I will simply press Start, so this isn't a concern for me. The dishes, glassware, stainless cups, pots and pans, and utensils have come out pristine using Cascade Platinum with the Bosch 800. Sentence (English): I think I was spoiled by my last Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Lack of cycles and useable space ] || ---------------- || I think I was spoiled by my last Bosch dishwasher. It was 14 years old so when it needed repairs I opted to get a new version. First mistake I bought this online without seeing it in person. The interior seems smaller than my previous version. The drop down tines do nothing to provide more space. I should have kept the double utensil basket from my previous model as well as the racks. This version has 1 small utensil holder.The third rack isn't working out to hold silverware. The silverware won't stay between the tines. The frustrating issue for me is lack of cycles. This model does not have a rinse only cycle or express cycle. I haven't found on the app any help for cycles. The cleaning is great, the sound is almost nonexistent The sanitize and crystal dry work great but add a lot of time to the cycle. The on position is extremely sensitive. You barely touch it to come to life then you only have 4 seconds to start the cycle and shut the door.I haven't figured out how to set for delay or any of the other things it may be able to do. I get more help from you tube videos than any printed material that was with the dishwasher. If I had seen this in person I would have bumped up or down models to get what I use. I could have sent it back but chose to keep it. I added photos of tines down then up to demonstrate lack of usefulness.

Comments (English): [ Beware of Samsung Appliances ] || ---------------- || I purchased the Samsung Model DW80R7060UG back in 2022. This dishwasher was used maybe 30 times in that period. I called around to quite a few appliance repair companies and finally found one that repairs Samsung appliances. Most all do not because Samsung doesn't stand behind their own parts, from what I was told. The technician explained that the mother board is located at the bottom of the unit, right where the water would go if it sprung a leak. Devilishly genius. This tech came to my house 3 times trying to fix the original problem. The unit would send an error code and he would get the correct part. He would install the part and a new error code would pop up. The long and the short of it was, the cost to repair it would be just about what I paid for it. I called Samsung to no avail. Basically, they are manufacturing throw away units and charging like it's a high-end product. I decided NOT to go down the rabbit hole trying to repair this unit. Even if they were able to fix it, the repair most likely wouldn't have lasted. BEWARE of this model number and do plenty of research on other Samsung units before buying. There were glowing recommendations of this unit on the website from the place I bought it. I believe they were compensated in some way due to it saying the review was incentivized.What was good: It was super quiet, it did a great job cleaning the dishes, it had a sleek style and matched all my other Samsung appliances.

Sentence (English): I ordered a dishwasher from Costco Online on 7/8/2024.
Comments (English): [ The delivery was a nightmare!  ] || ---------------- || I ordered a dishwasher from Costco Online on 7/8/2024. On the first delivery attempt on 7/19, the installer arrived with the wrong model and couldn't remove the old dishwasher, which was tiled in. I contacted customer service, uninstalled the old appliance ourselves, and rescheduled for 7/27, specifying that we only needed delivery and haul-away, not installation. On 7/27, no one showed up. I called Costco and was informed that the delivery team didn't work on Saturdays, and I still don't understand how I was scheduled for it if they don't work on Saturdays! So the delivery was rescheduled to 8/1. The day before, delivery personnel repeatedly called, seeming confused about what was needed. I confirmed that we only required delivery and haul-away. On 8/1, only the old appliance was taken away, and no new dishwasher was delivered. I was told that a dent was found on the new dishwasher afterwards, which they didn't say a word the day before, and another team even called to confirm whether I already had the dishwasher from the first attempt. I confirmed I did not, so a fourth delivery was scheduled for 8/16. The dishwasher was finally delivered on 8/16, which was not easy either. No one contacted me to give the delivery window until about 9 am on 8/16. And they arrived way later than the window was provided (10am-2pm). I requested compensation for the repeated issues and delays. Costco initially offered $75, based on $25 per missed delivery. I argued this did not reflect the time and inconvenience endured, but they maintain a maximum compensation of $100. I know they are third parties doing the delivery, but I don't think Costco can walk away saying they do everything right for their customer. Also the customer service insists on only $75 should be given as compensation is really outrageous.
